mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth reverts below 2% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST growth reverses within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth reverses within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is growing at an annualized rate below 1.5%, the real interest rate is high, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the real interest rate falls below 1% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past two months signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in 2 months
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and tightening labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS growth reverses within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the past quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if it occurs during a period of rising interest rates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 growth rebounds within the next quarter.
